provenance.canonical-source: apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/dialog.tsx — ten exported parts (Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogPortal, DialogClose, DialogOverlay, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogFooter, DialogTitle, DialogDescription) over radix-ui's Dialog. Every STYLE value below comes from this file. primitives/packages/react/dialog/src/dialog.tsx was read for BEHAVIOR ONLY (modal default, FocusScope trapped+loop, hideOthers, RemoveScroll, DismissableLayer dismiss rules, the onCloseAutoFocus focus-return, titlePresent/descriptionPresent aria wiring) and never for a style cell. Cross-checked but NOT canonical: apps/v4/registry/bases/radix/ui/dialog.tsx, a `cn-dialog-*` class-token variant of the same element whose values live in a separate stylesheet — the same treatment input.shadcn.json gave the bases/radix input. Examples: examples/{dialog-demo,dialog-close-button}.tsx. Docs: content/docs/components/radix/dialog.mdx (its section list — Composition, Custom Close Button, No Close Button, Sticky Footer, Scrollable Content, RTL — read to confirm which behaviours shadcn documents at all).
provenance.alert-dialog-scope: apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/alert-dialog.tsx was read only to fix the scope boundary and is EXCLUDED: it is a separate canonical row in docs/COMPONENTS.md, it has a `size?: "default" | "sm"` prop this Dialog does not, a media slot, centred-then-left-aligned header grid rules, dedicated Action/Cancel parts, and no close X. See docs/DIALOG-MATRIX.md scope note.
provenance.surface: DialogContent class `bg-background` -> --background (globals.css:101 light / :144 dark). Also the ring-offset colour on the close button (`ring-offset-background`).
provenance.fg: DialogContent sets NO text-colour class, so its children inherit the ambient --foreground (globals.css:102 / :145). Recorded as an ambient inheritance, exactly as input.shadcn.json and select.shadcn.json record theirs — but note that here it IS declared on the panel by the bg-background/foreground pairing, which is why style.panel.color is on for shadcn and off for the other two.
provenance.fg-secondary: DialogDescription class `text-muted-foreground` -> --muted-foreground (globals.css:112 / :155). The only de-emphasised text role in the file.
provenance.border-base: DialogContent's bare `border` utility with no colour class -> --border (globals.css:117 / :160). The 1px width is Tailwind's undeclared default (docs/foundations/border-style.md).
provenance.scrim-bg: DialogOverlay class `bg-black/50`. Tailwind v4 compiles an alpha modifier on an opaque colour to color-mix(in oklab, <color> 50%, transparent); --color-black is #000. Mode-invariant: there is no dark: variant on the overlay. Contrast Salt, whose light-mode scrim is WHITE at 65%.
provenance.shadow-lg: DialogContent class `shadow-lg`. [R] — Tailwind's documented default two-layer value; the package is not vendored in this clone, the same unvendored-package caveat select.shadcn.json's shadow-md carries. docs/foundations/elevation.md records that shadcn has no elevation foundation at all.
provenance.radius-panel: DialogContent `rounded-lg` -> --radius-lg: var(--radius) (globals.css:52) -> --radius: 0.625rem (globals.css:100) = 10px. NOTE this is the FULL radius, where shadcn's own input/select trigger use --radius-md (x0.8 = 8px) — a dialog is rounder than the controls inside it.
provenance.radius-close: close button `rounded-xs`. [R] AND FLAGGED: globals.css defines --radius-sm through --radius-4xl but NOT --radius-xs, so this single utility falls through to Tailwind's own default theme value (0.125rem = 2px) instead of shadcn's --radius scale. Recorded as a gap in shadcn's own token coverage rather than silently mapped onto --radius-sm.
provenance.type-title: DialogTitle class `text-lg leading-none font-semibold` = 600 1.125rem with line-height 1 — `leading-none` overrides text-lg's paired 1.75rem line-height. Family read as the generic Tailwind sans stack per the button/input/select/tooltip precedent (no font-family utility anywhere in dialog.tsx).
provenance.type-body: DialogDescription class `text-sm` = 0.875rem/1.25rem. A FLAT text-sm, so INPUT-MATRIX.md finding 9's missing-@media gap does not bite this row.
provenance.media-gap: DECLARED @media GAP, four utilities. dialog.tsx carries sm: variants at Tailwind's 640px breakpoint: DialogContent `sm:max-w-lg` (below 640px only max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] applies), DialogHeader `text-center sm:text-left`, DialogFooter `flex-col-reverse ... sm:flex-row sm:justify-end`. This generator emits flat rules with no at-rule channel (INPUT-MATRIX.md finding 9), so the >=640px desktop form is carried in the cells — max-width 32rem, left-aligned header text, a right-aligned action ROW — and the <640px form is recorded here: max-width calc(100% - 2rem), centred header text, and a REVERSED column of actions (primary action on top).
provenance.no-max-height: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: there is no max-h utility of any kind on DialogContent, and no overflow handling anywhere in dialog.tsx. A shadcn dialog with long content grows past the viewport; the docs' 'Scrollable Content' section solves it per instance, not in the component. Salt caps height per size and adds two nested scroll containers.
provenance.no-status-no-size: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: dialog.tsx has no status/tone axis and no size prop. Its SIBLING alert-dialog.tsx does have `size?: "default" | "sm"` — recorded so a future reader does not import it across.
provenance.close-button-focus-pseudo: the close button's ring rules use `focus:`, not `focus-visible:` — unlike the trigger rings on shadcn's own input.tsx and select.tsx. The skeleton applies them on :focus-visible, so a mouse click does not leave a ring; the divergence is declared in the template's style.close-button.focus note rather than hidden.
provenance.animation-defaults: DialogOverlay: data-[state=open]:animate-in fade-in-0 (+ the closing mirror). DialogContent: data-[state=open]:animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-95 (+ mirror) with `duration-200`. The utility lists and the 200ms duration ARE sourced [S]; the easing is tw-animate-css / Tailwind default (ease-out) and that package is not vendored in this clone, so easing is [R] — the same caveat TOOLTIP-MATRIX.md and select.shadcn.json record. The keyframes dialog-fade-in/-out and dialog-zoom-in/-out are appended to page/chrome.css.
provenance.transition-defaults: close button `transition-opacity` — the property is sourced [S]; 150ms / cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) are Tailwind's defaults and Tailwind is not vendored, so [R].

behavior.aria-modal.source: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, and deliberate: primitives/packages/react/dialog/src/dialog.tsx sets role="dialog" but never aria-modal, with the source comment 'aria-hide everything except the content (better supported equivalent to setting aria-modal)'

behavior.background-suppression.source: primitives dialog.tsx DialogContentModal: `const content = contentRef.current; if (content) return hideOthers(content)` — the aria-hidden package, which sets aria-hidden="true" on every sibling. Pointer suppression is separate (disableOutsidePointerEvents on DismissableLayer).

behavior.focus-trap.source: primitives dialog.tsx DialogContentImpl wraps the layer in <FocusScope asChild loop trapped={trapFocus}>; DialogContentModal passes trapFocus={context.open}

behavior.initial-focus.source: FocusScope's onMountAutoFocus default; Radix exposes onOpenAutoFocus as an escape hatch but no index prop, so there is no Salt-style initialFocus ordinal

behavior.focus-return.source: primitives dialog.tsx DialogContentModal onCloseAutoFocus: `event.preventDefault(); context.triggerRef.current?.focus()` — an EXPLICIT restore, not a library default

behavior.dismiss-outside.source: DismissableLayer pointerdown-outside -> onDismiss. Two guards in DialogContentModal: right-click and ctrl+left-click are prevented (`if (isRightClick) event.preventDefault()`), and onFocusOutside is prevented so a focusout while trapped cannot dismiss.

behavior.scroll-lock.source: primitives dialog.tsx wraps the modal overlay in <RemoveScroll> (react-remove-scroll)

behavior.described-by.source: primitives dialog.tsx: aria-describedby={context.descriptionPresent ? concatAriaDescribedby(ariaDescribedby, context.descriptionId) : ariaDescribedby} — wired only when a Description is actually mounted. The one system of the three that does this.

behavior.exit-animation.source: Radix Presence keeps the content mounted while data-state="closed" plays data-[state=closed]:animate-out fade-out-0 zoom-out-95 at duration-200

behavior.scroll-region-focusable.note: no scroll region exists, so there is nothing to make focusable

prop.size.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE on Dialog. Its sibling alert-dialog.tsx DOES take size?: "default" | "sm" (data-[size=sm]:max-w-xs) — one of the structural reasons alert-dialog is a separate canonical row.

prop.status.note: no status/tone axis of any kind

prop.disable-dismiss.note: no prop; a consumer prevents onPointerDownOutside per instance instead

prop.disable-scrim.note: DialogOverlay is rendered unconditionally by DialogContent — removing it is a source edit, not an instance toggle. Same class of expressibility gap as shadcn's always-on tooltip arrow.

prop.show-close-button.source: dialog.tsx has TWO props of this name: DialogContent's showCloseButton defaults to TRUE (renders the corner X), DialogFooter's defaults to FALSE (renders a composed <Button variant="outline">Close</Button>)

state.content-overflow.note: no overflow detection anywhere in dialog.tsx

state.close-button-interaction.source: dialog.tsx close button: opacity-70 at rest, hover:opacity-100, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2, data-[state=open]:bg-accent, disabled:pointer-events-none
